_comment: Held-out set for the phase 2 decision. These are reworded and synonym queries: the words a reader might use when they do not know the words the docs use. Written before any model was scored, and never used to tune weights or pick a model. The set is not rigged against keyword search: some queries share most of their words with the target page's title, others share none, so keyword search can win on part of it. Same format as queries.json: 'expect' lists URL fragments of a page that genuinely answers the query, and a result is a hit when any fragment is a substring of its URL. Every target was checked against src/content. 'inkeep_hit' stays null, Inkeep is not compared on this set.
